page.layout: One full-page engraving, no printed text block. Top right corner: folio number "Fol. 89" in italic. Figure A: a dissected animal (dog-like) suspended, labelled "fig. A" at top and letters A to H on the body. Figure B, right: a bladder/intestine with ligatures, labelled "fig. B" with letters A, B, C, D. Figure C, left: a tube-like organ with letters A to O, labelled "fig. C". No text block.
page.notes: This page is an engraved plate with no running text. The figure labels are letters inside the engraving, not text blocks. Fig. A labels visible: A (body), B, C, D, E, F, G, H (abdomen). Fig. C labels visible: A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, K, L, M, N, O. Fig. B labels visible: A, B, C, D. Folio marking "Fol. 89" printed at top right. Letters are small and partly illegible in places; they are not transcribed as text because they belong to the engraving.
